# Clone Office

> Everyone on a team gets a clone: an AI that works like them, runs on their own computer, does
> their everyday work, and answers colleagues' clones for them, bringing back only the calls that
> person must make. Open source (MIT), for teams of about ten or fewer and useful to one person
> alone. This file is for an AI assistant setting it up for a person.

## Set it up for a person

- Needs Node.js 22.13 or later (`node --version`); install it from https://nodejs.org if missing.
- Run `npx -y clone-office` in a terminal and leave it running. It serves the app on 127.0.0.1
  (port 4417 or the next free one) and opens the person's browser.
- Invited to a team? Run `npx -y clone-office join "<invite link>"` instead: the same, with the
  team's office ready to join.
- The first steps happen in the browser and are the person's to answer: which AI the clone thinks
  with (their ChatGPT plan, their own Claude Code, an API key, or a local model), whether it may
  learn from their AI conversations on this computer (and which folders to leave out), and who
  they are. Do not answer these for them, and never paste keys or sign in on their behalf.
- To keep it running with no terminal open: `npx -y clone-office service install`
  (macOS LaunchAgent, Linux systemd user service, Windows Startup folder; `service uninstall`
  undoes it, `service status` tells).
- When something does not work: `npx -y clone-office doctor` checks Node, the clone's folder, the
  running app, the AI model's sign-in, the office and the login item, each with what to do.
- `npx clone-office --help` lists every command.

## What it keeps and where

- Everything the clone keeps is in `~/.clone-office` on the person's computer (`CLONE_OFFICE_HOME`
  moves it): memory, conversations, flows, skills, settings. Keys and sign-ins there are sealed;
  do not read, copy or edit that folder's files directly: the app is how they change.
- Colleagues' clones talk through the team's relay, which carries cards and requests only.

## Running a relay for a team

- One computer: open an office from the app (Settings › Office), or `npx -y clone-office relay`.
- A server: follow https://github.com/cgoinglove/clone-office/blob/main/guide/team-server.md
  (Docker: `.env` with `DOMAIN`, `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` and `COMPOSE_PROFILES=https`, then
  `docker compose up -d`; Caddy serves it over HTTPS). Or
  `npx -y clone-office relay --database <postgres url>` behind the person's own HTTPS proxy.
  Ask the person before opening firewall ports or changing DNS.

## More

- [README](https://github.com/cgoinglove/clone-office/blob/main/README.md): what it does and why.
- [Guide](https://github.com/cgoinglove/clone-office/tree/main/guide): how it works, for the person.
- [Claude Code plugin](https://github.com/cgoinglove/clone-office/tree/main/plugin): ask colleagues'
  clones from Claude Code (`claude plugin marketplace add cgoinglove/clone-office`, then
  `claude plugin install clone-office@clone-office`).
